name: EasiAuto
tagline: 自动登录希沃白板的小工具，省掉每次手动输账号密码
taglineEn: Automatically signs in to Seewo Whiteboard so you do not type the password every time
description: EasiAuto 是一款自动登录希沃白板的小工具，省掉每次手动输账号、密码的那一步：电脑开机后它会自动把希沃白板登录好，直接进到上课界面，简化课前准备流程。适合教室电脑使用固定账号、又不希望密码人尽皆知的场景。
descriptionEn: EasiAuto automatically logs in to Seewo Whiteboard after the PC starts, going straight to the lesson screen and simplifying lesson preparation. It suits classroom PCs that use a fixed account without exposing the password.
author: hxabcd
